# Excalidraw 0.18.0 fonts

Font sources: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/817d8c553c3389650f8b4503984a6d4a5d2f0c11/packages/excalidraw/fonts

The application uses the WOFF2 files supplied with Excalidraw 0.18.0, except
Liberation Sans, which is replaced by the audited 2.1.5 OFL release below.
The canvas build copies their companion FONT-NOTICES.md and license manifest.
The per-file embedded copyright/license metadata is recorded there. A font's
license is independent of Excalidraw's MIT code license.

| Family | License / evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Assistant | OFL-1.1; embedded copyright and license; Reserved Font Name Source remains preserved |
| Cascadia Code | Microsoft's accompanying font license, based on OFL; the exact embedded text is reproduced, including Microsoft copyright |
| Comic Shanns | MIT; the full embedded MIT notice and all listed authors are reproduced |
| Excalifont | OFL-1.1; upstream `fonts/Excalifont/index.ts` preserves the complete original font license and Excalidraw copyright |
| Liberation Sans 2.1.5 | Replaces the old 1.05 font; OFL-1.1, Google / Red Hat notices and Reserved Font Names retained; original TTF and verified WOFF2 supplied in `../fonts/liberation-sans/` |
| Lilita One | OFL-1.1; embedded license URL and Juan Montoreano copyright / Reserved Font Names |
| Nunito | OFL-1.1; embedded license URL and Nunito Project Authors copyright |
| Virgil | OFL-1.1; full license is in the supplied font's name table |
| Xiaolai | OFL-1.1; LXGW copyright retained; pinned upstream `fonts/Xiaolai/index.ts` records the original full-font OFL grant before splitting |

Excalifont license evidence:
https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/817d8c553c3389650f8b4503984a6d4a5d2f0c11/packages/excalidraw/fonts/Excalifont/index.ts

License text: ../licenses/OFL-1.1.txt. The full Comic Shanns and Cascadia texts
are reproduced from the actual distributed fonts in FONT-NOTICES.md.
No supplied font is renamed, modified or sold by itself by AIDesignHub.

Liberation source and conversion record: ../fonts/liberation-sans/UPSTREAM.json.
WOFF2 compression uses no glyph subsetting and keeps all original font tables,
including name/copyright/license metadata, with only required WOFF2 header and
checksum changes. This follows OFL FAQ 2.2.1:
https://openfontlicense.org/ofl-faq/ .

Xiaolai license evidence:
https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/817d8c553c3389650f8b4503984a6d4a5d2f0c11/packages/excalidraw/fonts/Xiaolai/index.ts
